title: חנן המצרי

paragraphs: Chanan the Egyptian, colleague of Chanan ben Avshalom and a judge: end of Ketubot. Tosafot there, 105a, writes that he was not more important than Chanan ben Avshalom, but was of better lineage, and was therefore put first. See Chananyah of Ono and Shimon HaTimni above.
